purpose: Close direct target-group, employer-demand and scale/distribution evidence gaps without using project activities as evidence.

streams.population: potentially eligible adults >29 from Sud-Vest Oltenia, Sud-Muntenia and Centru
streams.precondition: document the recruitment/research frame, channels, dates, region and eligibility screening; do not call results representative of regional population unless a probability frame exists
claim_limits: self-assessment is not objective competence certification
interest in training is not proof of skill deficit
non-probability sample cannot estimate prevalence for all adults in a region
project target of 160 cannot be used as sample universe

streams.population: employers / business associations / relevant organisations in the three project regions

privacy.named_expression_of_interest: stored separately from analytical raw dataset if collected
privacy.analysis_dataset: organisation ID only unless explicit publication consent

claim_limits: strategic interest does not equal shortage
one employer cannot establish regional prevalence
demand for a tool/vendor does not establish a general competency need

acceptance_gates: all three regions represented or missing region explicitly remains an evidence gap
response counts and denominators reported for every quantitative claim
raw responses reconcile exactly to aggregates
adult and employer evidence stored separately before triangulation
exact 160 and 80/40/40 remain design values unless independently supported
